description: Collection of online course completion certificates and training records. These entries are records of course completions; many entries may not have an issuer verification URL.
visibility_policy: Metadata is public. Certificate PDFs may contain personal data — consider keeping PDFs private, encrypted, or providing them on request.
notes: For course completions without verification URLs, set verification_url: null and add verification_instructions or evidence_url (private link) for verifiers.
